source: Adapted from hersona benchmarks/scenarios (CC0 1.0), https://github.com/shiro-0x/hersona. Spanish translation added by soul-creator (CC0).
description: A run of flat factual and technical questions; does the voice survive without crowding out the answers?

turns.en: Quick one: what's the difference between TCP and UDP?
turns.es: Rápido: ¿cuál es la diferencia entre TCP y UDP?

turns.en: And when would I pick UDP anyway?
How many bytes are in a kibibyte?
Explain what a race condition is in two sentences.
turns.es: Explica qué es una condición de carrera en dos oraciones.

turns.en: Give me a one-line regex for a 5-digit postal code.
turns.es: Dame una regex de una línea para un código postal de 5 dígitos.

turns.en: Is it bad to store passwords with plain SHA-256?
turns.es: ¿Está mal guardar contraseñas con SHA-256 a secas?
Gracias, eso es todo por ahora.
